- **BR-PG1-232** — Registered-unsubscribed agents can list exactly 1 free property; a second attempt triggers the paywall; subscribed = unlimited. _(§ Property Edge Cases)_
- **BR-PG1-233** — External listing view CTAs: Download (PDF), Save (shortlist), Share (Email, Whatsapp), View Phone number; Self view CTAs: Deactivate, Edit, Delete (top), View Response (bottom). _(§ View Property/Demand flows)_
- **BR-PG1-234** — Demand Carpet Area and Location are checked at submission; high-value demands are routed exclusively to the Keydemand team and not matched to agents. _(§ Demand BR1, 11)_
- **BR-PG1-235** — Agents may get a no-CTA notification that x demands exist in their area, to prompt property posting. _(§ Demand BR2)_
- **BR-PG1-236** — Only the Keydemand team can explore/search demands; front-end users (agents, brands) get matches via backend relevancy (agents: F&B, Retail, Office only). _(§ Demand BR3, 17; Blackout Rule)_
- **BR-PG1-237** — Office tenant city threshold (e.g., 5,000 sq ft Mumbai): exceeding demands are transferred to Keydemand, not an agency. _(§ Demand BR4)_
- **BR-PG1-238** — Enterprise bulk demand upload via Excel is required. _(§ Demand BR5)_
- **BR-PG1-239** — Registered, subscribed and expired users get WhatsApp alerts for inbound leads and market summaries. _(§ Demand BR6)_
- **BR-PG1-240** — Agents can post demands for clients within their subscription asset classes and cities; they see only demands matching their registered asset class and city. _(§ Demand BR7, 9)_
- **BR-PG1-241** — Supplier "request to connect" on a demand: poster has 72 hours; otherwise auto-nullified with system rejection. _(§ Demand BR10; 72-Hour SLA)_
- **BR-PG1-242** — A tenant self-selecting 'Enterprise Solution' on a demand transfers it immediately to the Keydemand admin team. _(§ Demand BR11)_
- **BR-PG1-243** — Demand detail page shows the requester a real-time list of "Interested Properties"/"Matched Listings". _(§ Demand BR12)_
- **BR-PG1-244** — High-value demands handled by Keydemand show "Assigned to Keydemand Specialist." in self-view. _(§ Demand BR14)_
- **BR-PG1-245** — Demand deactivation stops matching; demands auto-move to "Inactive" after a set period (e.g., 60 days) if not renewed. _(§ Demand BR15)_
- **BR-PG1-246** — Office demand: 1 fixed location + up to 4 other interested locations. _(§ Demand BR19; Agent step 3)_
- **BR-PG1-247** — Projects are matched against all demands using key fields; no relevancy percentage shown. _(§ Demand BR20)_
- **BR-PG1-248** — Flex Demand (Keydemand) is Phase 2. _(§ Demand BR21)_
- **BR-PG1-249** — Office occupier demand CTA is "View phone number"; others "Request phone number". _(§ Demand BR22)_
- **BR-PG1-250** — Expired agents cannot view pushed demands or request contact. _(§ Demand Edge Cases)_
- **BR-PG1-251** — Projects are flagged in admin as regular, sponsored or exclusive; sponsored = developer-paid, city-specific, limited slots (e.g., 3–5 per city); exclusive = mandated solely to Keydemand, nationwide banner/carousel independent of city. _(§ Project Management 5–7)_
- **BR-PG1-252** — Distinct visual markers (golden star, ribbon, asterisk) differentiate standard properties, regular, sponsored and exclusive projects. _(§ Project Management 8)_
- **BR-PG1-253** — Property images are blurred for unregistered users while project images are shown, to capture a mobile number. _(§ Project Management 9)_
- **BR-PG1-254** — Project page: filters Location, Asset Class, transaction type; detail shows Brochures, Floorplans, Built-Up Area, Possession Date; CTAs "Show Interest" or "WhatsApp". _(§ Project Management 1–4)_
- **BR-PG1-255** — Unregistered project interest → form → lead to project RM, assigned Keydemand team, admin, stored under the project; registered → auto-captured, CTA "interest shown on this project on <date>". _(§ Project Management 10–11)_
- **BR-PG1-256** — Agent notification timing: Demand Relevancy instant (bulk summary if many); Property Relevancy, Image Request, Phone number Request instant; Subscriptions 3 days prior & same day; Marketing from Keydemand; New Projects Uploaded instant (bulk to new users); Demand/Property Active Status once every 3 months (keep active or deactivate per response). _(§ Agent Specific Home Page › NavBar 6)_
- **BR-PG1-257** — Notification templates for demand relevancy, property relevancy (solo/multiple/weekly), image request and phone number request as transcribed. _(§ Notifications content)_
- **BR-PG1-258** — WhatsApp/SMS notifications are categorised Transactional (mandatory) vs Promotional (opt-out toggles). _(§ Hamburger 7)_
- **BR-PG1-259** — Image requests received support "Bulk Approve Verified" and a per-property filter. _(§ Body › Image request)_
- **BR-PG1-260** — Outbound image request status is shown on the card itself; on acceptance the card shows a view phone number button; stored in Hamburger › Enquiries, not on the dashboard yet. _(§ Body › Image request requested)_
- **BR-PG1-278** — NavBar "Free Listing" is shown only to unregistered users and is not an option in any other journey; the navbar is not universal and changes per user-specific page; free listing is limited per asset class and disappears once the quota is over. _(§ Agent Specific Home Page › Business Rules)_
- **BR-PG1-279** — Explore Properties redirects straight to the explore page for the user's selected asset class; if Retail, F&B and Office are selected show Office first, else Retail; all transaction types default to lease. _(§ Agent Specific Home Page › Business Rules; Header 3)_
- **BR-PG1-280** — Image request display: Accepted → images shown only to the requesting user; Pending → "pending" shown on the card; Rejected → images stay hidden and a CTA is shown to the requester. Image requests do not expire (72-hour nullification not applied) and the preview status applies uniformly to all users. _(§ Display logic for the image request status; Body › Image request)_
- **BR-PG1-281** — Phone number viewed is a passive event needing no approval; it is a two-way reveal — the lister gets the viewer's Name, User type, Mobile number and the property/demand viewed, and is notified via WhatsApp; the lead stays "Unread" until clicked. _(§ Body › Phone number viewed)_
- **BR-PG1-282** — Outbound phone number requests: a brand rejection still counts toward the 5 free lifetime clicks; brand/supplier has 4 working days (skipping Saturday and Sunday) to accept/reject; requests unanswered after 72 hours fall under Rejected; a 6th request prompts "Kindly subscribe to continue". _(§ Body › Phone number requested)_
- **BR-PG1-283** — Delete Account is a form; on receipt the Keydemand team reaches out to the agent and deletes the account. Deactivate Account needs dialog confirmation, hides all listings and marks the agent inactive; "Reactivate account" on the home page returns them as registered-not-subscribed — within the original subscription period benefits resume (listings must be manually reactivated), outside it they must subscribe again or are prompted on any CTA. _(§ Account Management; Hamburger 2)_
- **BR-PG1-284** — Agent access by state (① Non-registered, ② Registered-not-subscribed, ③ Subscribed, ④ Expired): landing page, explore properties (limited for ①) and project page — all; property page and contact CTA — ②③ (② max 5 requests, ③ unlimited); Subscribe now — ①②④; Dashboard — ②③④ (④ may be read-only); Profile — ②③④; Post property/demand — ②③ (② 1 listing, ③ unlimited); WhatsApp alerts — ②③④. _(§ Access & Permissions for each type of Agent)_

### All User Journeys in Keydemand V2  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Google Doc · ID `1lyX8vwFoW48XPY6L6QjtH-DQT0f60Zw0D2ZYmIU7X4U` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-10-06 · sections read: 1–12 (all user types) · no comments · read coverage: 100%

#### Content

##### 1. Property Agent
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **List Properties & Demands:** Upload commercial property inventory and client space requirements across Office, Retail, and F&B asset classes.
  - **Trial Allowance:** Use a free trial plan with 1 property listing or 1 demand posting, and 5 lifetime contact reveals.
  - **Pro Subscription Upgrades:** Subscribe to a paid Pro Plan (Metro ₹1,000/mo, Non-Metro ₹750/mo, PAN India ₹5,000/mo) for unlimited property listings, unlimited contact reveals, and automated real-time WhatsApp lead alerts.
  - **Privacy Control:** Hide listing photos behind "Do Not Show Images" approval gates to protect direct sourcing.
  - **Match Management:** View automated property-demand matches and manage inbound contact/image requests on their dashboard.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Managed Space properties or Managed Space demands.
  - Cannot search or explore the global Demands Directory (matching happens automatically via backend relevancy).
  - Cannot view High-Ticket Demands exceeding city size thresholds (unless unlocked by Admins or posted by external agents >10,000 sq ft in Bangalore).
  - Cannot post or edit listings in cities or asset classes outside their active subscription/selection.

##### 2. Brand — Retail (Individual)
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Post Expansion Demands:** Post up to 3 free Retail space requirements (1 during onboarding + 2 post-registration).
  - **Explore Supply:** Browse and search commercial listings across Retail, F&B, and Office asset classes.
  - **Direct Contacts:** View up to 5 property contacts directly (sharing details over WhatsApp).
  - **SLA Control:** Accept or reject inbound agent connection requests on their demands within a 4-working-days SLA window.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post F&B, Office, or Managed Space demands.
  - Cannot post a 4th demand without upgrading to an Enterprise plan.
  - Cannot search or explore the global Demands Directory.
  - Cannot post property supply listings.

##### 3. Brand — F&B (Individual)
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Post Expansion Demands:** Post up to 3 free F&B space requirements (1 during onboarding + 2 post-registration).
  - **Explore Supply:** Browse commercial property listings across F&B, Retail, and Office asset classes.
  - **Direct Contacts:** View up to 5 property contacts directly (sharing details over WhatsApp).
  - **SLA Control:** Accept or reject inbound agent connection requests on their demands within a 4-working-days SLA window.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Retail, Office, or Managed Space demands. Cannot post a 4th demand without upgrading to an Enterprise plan.
  - Cannot search or explore the global Demands Directory.
  - Cannot post property supply listings.

##### 4. Office Tenant (Individual)
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Post Office Search:** Post 1 free Office space demand (with an option to indicate interest in Managed Space during onboarding).
  - **Explore Supply:** Search properties and developer projects across Office and Managed Space categories.
  - **Two-Way Reveal:** Click "View Phone Number" to instantly trigger a two-way contact exchange via WhatsApp (sharing landlord details with the tenant and tenant details with the landlord without manual approval delays).
  - **Direct Unlocks:** View up to 5 property contacts directly.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Retail or F&B demands, nor post property supply listings. But if they opt for Managed Supply during registration, they can post Managed Space too.
  - Cannot post a 2nd demand without upgrading to an Enterprise plan.
  - Cannot search or explore the global Demands Directory.
  - Demands exceeding high-value size thresholds (e.g., 5,000 sq ft in Mumbai) bypass public agent feeds and route exclusively to Keydemand.

##### 5. Managed Space Tenant / Occupier (Individual)
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Post Seat Requirements:** Post 1 free Managed Space seat/workspace requirement.
  - **Explore Workspace Supply:** Search coworking hubs, operator centers, and Office properties.
  - **Two-Way Reveal:** View property contacts via instant Two-Way Reveal (routing details directly to Keydemand / space operators).
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Office, Retail, or F&B demands, nor post property supply listings.
  - Cannot post a 2nd demand or requirements >20 seats without upgrading to an Enterprise plan.
  - Posted requirements are strictly hidden from external agents/operators and visible **only** to the internal Keydemand team.
  - Cannot search or explore the global Demands Directory.

##### 6. Enterprise Brand — Retail
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Corporate Portal Access:** Log in via unique mobile numbers & OTP for regional expansion representatives under a single corporate brand account.
  - **Auto-Fill Formats:** Use pre-configured brand templates (store format, carpet area, frontage) to deploy multi-city requirements in seconds.
  - **Centralized Tracking:** Access dedicated Point of Contact (POC) details, multi-user demand tracking, and CRM lead statuses (Approved/Rejected/Open).
  - **Bulk Uploads:** Share bulk expansion sheets via Excel with their assigned Keydemand Relationship Manager (RM) for Control Panel uploads.
  - **Explore Supply:** Browse Retail, F&B, and Office property listings.
  - POC can do edits, delete, and deactivate on their behalf
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post F&B or Office demands.
  - Representatives cannot self-manage sub-user accounts or edit demands posted by other team members (managed via Admin Control Panel).
  - Requirements bypass public agent feeds entirely for private blackout servicing

##### 7. Enterprise Brand — F&B
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Corporate Portal Access:** Log in via individual representative mobile numbers & OTP under a unified corporate brand account.
  - **Auto-Fill Formats:** Use pre-set F&B templates (seating, kitchen, utility specs) to post requirements across multiple locations.
  - **Centralized Tracking:** View assigned Keydemand POC details, multi-user demand tracking, and portfolio metrics.
  - **Bulk Uploads:** Submit multi-city requirements via Excel to their Keydemand RM for central upload.
  - POC can do edits, delete, and deactivate on their behalf
  - **Explore Supply:** Browse F&B, Retail, and Office property supply.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Retail or Office demands.
  - Representatives cannot manage sub-user accounts or edit colleague postings directly.
  - Requirements bypass public agent feeds for private, offline servicing.

##### 8. Enterprise Office Tenant
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Corporate Expansion Access:** Access multi-user regional team logins under a single corporate organization.
  - **Post Requirements:** Post large-scale Office and Managed Space demands (If opted for during registration) via direct entry or bulk Excel upload with their assigned Keydemand RM.
  - POC can do edits, delete, and deactivate on their behalf
  - **Explore Supply:** Search Office and Managed Space properties and projects.
  - **Portfolio Tools:** Access dedicated POC handholding, workspace analytics.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Retail or F&B, managed space office demands.
  - Cannot self-manage sub-user accounts on the front end.
  - Large-ticket requirements bypass public agent feeds and are serviced privately by Keydemand.

##### 9. Enterprise Managed Office Tenant
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Bulk Seat Search:** Access corporate portal logins for team seat requirements (>20 seats).
  - **Post Requirements:** Post Managed Space demands with dedicated POC assistance and bulk upload support.
  - **Explore Supply:** Search Managed Space hubs, flex centers, and Office properties.
  - POC can do edits, delete, and deactivate on their behalf
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot post Retail or F&B demands.
  - Requirements are completely blacked out from external agents/operators and accessible **only** to Keydemand's internal execution team.
  - Cannot self-manage sub-users or edit colleague postings directly.

##### 10. Keydemand Team (Internal Execution Team)
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Exclusive Directory Search:** **The ONLY user group authorized to search, filter, and explore the global Demands Directory**.
  - **Advanced Overseer Access:** Bypass hidden image locks (viewing photos overlaid with "Hidden to others") and bypass contact paywalls.
  - **Full Inventory Capabilities:** Post and manage properties and demands across all asset classes (Office, Retail, F&B, Managed Space).
  - **Lead & High-Ticket Management:** Manage High-Ticket Leads (HTLs), Exclusive Projects, and assigned Enterprise accounts.
  - **Broker Monitoring:** Audit onboarded broker activity (requirements added, contact attempts, missed calls) via a monitoring panel.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - Cannot edit, delete, or deactivate user profiles via the front-end (must be executed via backend Control Panel).
  - Cannot edit or delete colleague listings (Read-Only access to colleagues' data under "KD Listings").
  - Cannot post or edit demands on behalf of Enterprise brands via front-end (must use backend Control Panel bulk upload).

##### 11. Developer
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Feature Projects:** Display commercial or residential real estate developments as "Projects" (Standard, Premium/Sponsored, or Exclusive) across target cities.
  - **Receive Direct Leads:** Receive project inquiry leads routed directly to their contact person, assigned Keydemand RM
  - **View Projects:** View their published project pages on the platform.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - **No Front-End Login/Registration:** Onboarded strictly offline via the backend Control Panel by Keydemand Admins.
  - **Cannot Post Individual Property Cards:** Restricted strictly to uploading multi-unit "Projects".
  - Cannot self-upload or edit project data directly on the front-end.

##### 12. Managed Space Operator
- **What They Can Do:**
  - **Feature Centers & Hubs:** List flexible coworking centers, serviced offices, and workspace hubs as "Projects" under the Managed Space asset class.
  - **Receive Seat Leads:** Receive direct center inquiries and seat leads routed to their designated team and Keydemand RMs.
- **What They Cannot Do:**
  - **No Front-End Login/Registration:** Onboarded offline via the backend Control Panel by Keydemand Admins.
  - **Cannot List Standard Individual Properties:** Restricted strictly to listing center/hub "Projects".
  - Cannot post space demands or self-upload listings directly on the front-end.

#### Business rules extracted
- **BR-PG1-261** — Agent: lists properties and demands in Office, Retail, F&B only; free trial = 1 property listing or 1 demand posting + 5 lifetime contact reveals. _(§ 1)_
- **BR-PG1-262** — Agent Pro Plan: Metro ₹1,000/mo, Non-Metro ₹750/mo, PAN India ₹5,000/mo → unlimited listings, unlimited contact reveals, real-time WhatsApp lead alerts. _(§ 1)_
- **BR-PG1-263** — Agents cannot view High-Ticket Demands over city thresholds unless unlocked by Admins or posted by external agents >10,000 sq ft in Bangalore. _(§ 1)_
- **BR-PG1-264** — Agents cannot post/edit listings outside their active subscription/selection cities and asset classes. _(§ 1)_
- **BR-PG1-265** — No front-end user except the Keydemand team can search/explore the global Demands Directory. _(§ 1–9; § 10)_
- **BR-PG1-266** — Individual Retail brand: up to 3 free Retail demands (1 onboarding + 2 post-registration); explore Retail, F&B, Office; view up to 5 property contacts (shared over WhatsApp); cannot post F&B/Office/Managed Space demands, a 4th demand (needs Enterprise) or property listings. _(§ 2)_
- **BR-PG1-267** — Individual F&B brand: same as Retail but posts only F&B demands. _(§ 3)_
- **BR-PG1-268** — Individual brands accept/reject inbound agent connection requests within a 4-working-day SLA. _(§ 2–3)_
- **BR-PG1-269** — Individual Office Tenant: 1 free Office demand (Managed Space interest option at onboarding; may post Managed Space if opted); explore Office and Managed Space properties and projects; "View Phone Number" triggers instant two-way WhatsApp contact exchange with no approval; up to 5 contacts; 2nd demand needs Enterprise; demands above thresholds (e.g., 5,000 sq ft Mumbai) route only to Keydemand. _(§ 4)_
- **BR-PG1-270** — Individual Managed Space Occupier: 1 free seat requirement; explore coworking hubs, operator centres and Office; two-way reveal routed to Keydemand/operators; a 2nd demand or >20 seats needs Enterprise; requirements visible only to Keydemand. _(§ 5)_
- **BR-PG1-271** — Enterprise brands: per-representative mobile + OTP login under one brand account; brand format templates (Retail: store format, carpet area, frontage; F&B: seating, kitchen, utility specs); POC details, multi-user demand tracking, CRM lead statuses Approved/Rejected/Open; Excel bulk uploads via RM; POC can edit/delete/deactivate on their behalf; cannot self-manage sub-users or edit colleagues' demands; requirements bypass public agent feeds. _(§ 6–7)_
- **BR-PG1-272** — Enterprise Office Tenant: multi-user regional logins; post large Office (and Managed Space if opted) demands directly or via bulk Excel with RM; POC handholding and workspace analytics; no front-end sub-user management; large-ticket requirements serviced privately. _(§ 8)_
- **BR-PG1-273** — Enterprise Managed Office Tenant: team seat requirements >20 seats; Managed Space demands with POC and bulk upload; explore Managed Space hubs, flex centres, Office; fully blacked out from external agents/operators. _(§ 9)_
- **BR-PG1-274** — Keydemand Team: bypass hidden image locks (with "Hidden to others") and contact paywalls; post/manage properties and demands in all asset classes; manage HTLs, Exclusive Projects, assigned Enterprise accounts; audit broker activity (requirements added, contact attempts, missed calls) via a monitoring panel. _(§ 10)_
- **BR-PG1-275** — Keydemand Team cannot edit/delete/deactivate user profiles on the front end (Control Panel only), cannot edit/delete colleague listings (read-only under "KD Listings"), and cannot post/edit Enterprise brand demands on the front end (Control Panel bulk upload only). _(§ 10)_
- **BR-PG1-276** — Developers have no front-end login/registration (onboarded offline via Control Panel); they feature Projects (Standard, Premium/Sponsored, Exclusive), receive leads to their contact person and assigned RM, view their project pages; cannot post property cards or self-upload/edit project data. _(§ 11)_
- **BR-PG1-277** — Managed Space Operators have no front-end login (onboarded offline); list centres/hubs as Projects under Managed Space; receive seat leads to their team and Keydemand RMs; cannot list standard properties, post demands or self-upload. _(§ 12)_

#### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- Enterprise Office Tenant: "Post … Office and Managed Space demands (If opted…)" vs "Cannot post Retail or F&B, managed space office demands" — contradictory.
- Agent Pro Plan omits Rest of India (₹1,000) and combined bundle prices given in Agent V1.1.
- "unless unlocked by Admins" for High-Ticket Demands — unlock mechanism not specified elsewhere.
- "POC can do edits, delete, and deactivate on their behalf" vs Keydemand Team "Cannot post or edit demands on behalf of Enterprise brands via front-end".
- Developer/Operator "No Front-End Login/Registration" vs Landing V1.0 "List your Project >>" form with phone + OTP and "registered number → dashboard".

### Version 1.0 Brand-Retail Home Page- Specific Page  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Google Doc · ID `1Lx_0064buDmM6a_rjawrnDLoO1s1dMtnGlPq5-uYGLU` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-09-28 · tabs/sections read: Business Rules, Header, Hamburger(Profile), Body (single-tab doc) · read coverage: 100%

#### Content
##### Business Rules

**1. Onboarding, Registration, & Entry Rules**
- **Entry Point Convergence**: All users arriving via Social Media CTAs (such as LinkedIn or Meta ads) or through the direct website URL (Keydemand.in) must converge on the exact same registration URL.
- **Mandatory Registration Fields**: The onboarding flow requires capturing user details (Name, and mobile number verified via OTP) alongside a single active demand (capturing Asset class, transaction type, city, location, Carpet area, and Floor).
- **T&C Consent**: Registration is gated by a mandatory clickable tick-box to accept the platform's Terms and Conditions.
- **Initial Free Posting Quota**: Upon initial registration, 1 demand is added to the brand's account. Users can subsequently add up to 2 more demands, allowing for a total of **3 free demands**.
- **Enterprise Integration Trigger**: If a registering user selects the "Enquire for Enterprise Solution" option during onboarding, the lead must be instantly transferred to the internal Keydemand team.
- **Retail Microsite Redirection**: For users acquired specifically via social media CTAs, the post-registration landing page must redirect them to a city-specific **Microsite for Retail**. This microsite dynamically displays listing relevancy, a supply summary, and an option to explore other property options.

**2. Brand Posting Restrictions & Asset Locks**
- **Asset Posting Restrictions**: **Retail Brands** can post **only Retail demands**. They are strictly prohibited from posting other asset classes (such as F&B or Office). However, they are permitted to browse and view property cards outside of their asset class under the global "Explore Properties" header navigation. They can explore Retail, F&B and Office.
- **Post Caps**: **Retail Brands** are permitted to add further **Retail** demands *only* after they are officially onboarded as enterprise users (which is triggered once **3 demands** have been successfully posted).
- **Mandatory Brand Identity**: When a brand posts a demand, their official **company or brand name must be clearly displayed** on the listing.
- **Brand Logo and Card Display States**:
  - If a brand profile image has been uploaded by the user, it must display directly on their demand card.
  - If no brand logo is provided, the system must automatically select a relevant placeholder image based on the chosen asset class.

**3. Account Lifecycle (Deactivation & Deletion)**
- **Manual Account Deletion Flow**:
  - Brands submit deletion requests by filling out a designated Form located under the Profile section.
  - Upon receipt of the form, the Keydemand team must manually reach out to the user to finalize account deletion.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deleting a profile results in the **permanent deletion** of all associated inventory.
- **Account Deactivation Flow**:
  - Brands can deactivate their accounts instantly by clicking the "Deactivate Account" button under their profile, which triggers a confirmation dialog box.
  - Deactivating the account pauses all activity: the user is marked inactive, and **all active listings are hidden** from public view on the platform.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deactivating a profile **pauses and deactivates** associated inventory.
  - **Reactivation**: A deactivated brand can return and reactivate at any time via a **"Reactivate account"** button on their homepage.

**4. Live Brand Dashboard & Relevancy Matching**
- **Real-time Dashboard Metrics**: The home page must link to a live, impromptu dashboard displaying:
  - **Demand Listings**: A summary of the total number of the **Retail Brand**'s own demands across all asset classes, ordered newest first.
  - **Property Relevancy**: Total count of matching properties presented to the brand's demands.
  - **Leads/Enquiries**: Captures total phone number requests received.
  - **Enquiries Sent**: Captures contacts viewed, relevant projects, and outbound image requests.
- **My Demands Filters**: Under "My Demands", brands must be able to search and sort using:
  - *Filters*: Search by PropertyId, title, location, Asset Class, City, and Status (Active/Deactivated).
  - *Sorting*: Sort by newest first, most leads, and recent matches.
  - *Visual Priority*: Newest and unopened leads must be displayed first as cards.
- **Relevancy Sorting Priority**: Listings with active relevancy matches are automatically prioritized, pushed to the top of the feed, and flagged with a **red dot notification**.
- **Dynamic Relevancy Alerts**: Any new matched relevancy triggers a red dot over the dashboard counter. Clicking this tab automatically displays the latest matches at the top of the screen, highlighted with the red dot.
- **Leads Navigation**: Clicking on the dashboard "Leads" metric takes the brand directly to the Leads page, displaying open demands that have received leads (ordered newest first, displaying specific lead counts per location).

**5. Inbound & Outbound Phone Number Requests**
- **Outbound Contact Reveal Logic (Brand viewing Property)**:
  - The property supplier's contact details are gated behind a Call-to-Action (CTA).
  - When a logged-in Brand user clicks to view a property's contact number, **both parties gain access to each other's contact information**.
  - The contact details are shared over WhatsApp with the brand.
  - The property owner/lister instantly receives an in-app lead notification and a WhatsApp alert containing the **Brand Name, User Type, Mobile Number, and Property Viewed**.
  - The lead is marked **"Unread"** on the lister's dashboard until they open the details.
- **Inbound Contact Requests Received (Agents/Admins viewing Brand)**:
  - Tracks the number of phone numbers requested on the brand's listings.
  - *Fields captured*: Name, Mobile Number, Property/Demand/Project ID, User-Type, Timestamp, and Accept/Reject buttons.
- **Brand-Only Accept/Reject Actions**:
  - The manual Accept/Reject options on contact requests apply **strictly to Brands** (as their demand cards feature a "Request Contact" CTA).
  - **SLA Window**: The brand has **4 working days** (excluding Saturdays and Sundays) to accept or reject the contact request.
  - **72-Hour Expiry**: If a request remains unanswered after **72 hours**, it is automatically dropped, nullified, and moved to "Rejected" status.
- **Outbound System Notifications (Sent to Requesting User)**:
  - *Approved*: "Your request to view phone number has been approved, kindly connect with them on \<number\>".
  - *Rejected*: "Your request to view the number and connect has been disallowed".
  - *Nullified/Expired*: "Your request to view number and connect has been unanswered and thus dropped".

**6. Outbound Image Requests**
- **Image Request Tracker**: Outbound image requests sent by the **Retail Brand** to see similar properties must be tracked on a dedicated dashboard table.
- **Required Table Fields**: Project/Property ID (clickable and redirectable to the listing page), Asset Class, City, Location, Transaction Type, Posted By, and Date Requested.
- **Image Request Status Displays**:
  - **Accepted**: Shows the "Accepted" label with a **"View Images"** CTA (displays the property listing with images revealed).
  - **Pending**: Shows the "Pending" label (images remain locked).
  - **Rejected**: Shows the "Rejected" label with a **"View Listing without Images"** CTA (displays the listing without images).

**7. Dashboard Slider Interactions**
All dashboard summary metrics must open detailed sliding side panels according to this matrix:
- **Active Demand Card**: Clicking this scrolls the page down to the demands section.
- **Relevancy**: Clicking this scrolls the page down to the My Demands section.
- **Leads Received**: To see all leads, click "Leads Received." The slider will open and display all leads. When clicked on number of leads for demands, then it opens 2 tabs. It consists of phone number viewed, contact requests. **Phone number viewed** is on one tab where the slider will open and display the numbers viewed. and **Contact requests** received are on another. You can choose to accept or reject contact requests.
- **Enquiries Card**: To see the list of enquiries received, click "Enquiries Card." The slider will open and display all the enquiries with three tabs. **Projects Enquired:** To see a list of projects enquired, click "Projects Enquired." The slider will open and display the projects enquired, **Numbers Viewed:** It will open numbers viewed of agent, keydemand team and tenant, **Images Requested**: To see a list of images requested, click "Images Requested." The slider will open and display the images requested.
- **Your Listing - Demands**: To see the full list of your demands, click "Your Listing - Demands." The slider will open and display the list of demands.

**8. Interactive Projects & Callback Options**
- **Project Interest Inquiry**: Brands can show interest in Premium Projects, Exclusive Projects, or general city projects by clicking "Show Interest". This triggers a pre-filled form pulling details from their profile: **Name, Mobile, Email, and User Type**. Clicking submit displays the success message: "Thank you for showing interest".
- **Popular Cities Discovery**: Clicking "Explore" on popular city cards opens all properties and projects matching the chosen city.
- **Low-Abandonment Callback Button**: The "Request a Callback" button in the About section is designed to capture **only the mobile number as mandatory** to prevent form abandonment; name and email fields must be optional.
- **Calendly Booking Integration**: Submitting the callback form opens a specific Calendly link, allowing the brand user to book a slot for a live representative demo.

**9. Alerts, Notifications, & Support**
- **WhatsApp Notification Settings**: A toggle button under settings allows brands to choose whether they wish to receive notifications.
- **Notification Block Restriction**: Only promotional messages can be stopped; brands are strictly **blocked from disabling transactional WhatsApp messages** (e.g., matching relevancies, leads, interest received, or phone number enquiries).
- **Automated Confirmation Alerts**: When a brand adds a new demand, the platform automatically triggers a confirmation WhatsApp message to themselves containing the location details and a PDF download link of their listing.
- **Demand Active Status Alert**: An automated system check occurs **once every 3 months** to verify if the brand's demand is still active.
- **Help Desk**: Standard support is channeled via contact@keydemand.in along with a self-help chatbot utilizing standard website FAQs.

- Expired Status: Expired requests (unanswered after 72 hours) will fall under the Rejected status.

### Version 1.0 Brand- F&B Home Page - Specific Page  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Google Doc · ID `1OUHdFtGTXUTWsZOG6aQ1lv57K0ttI6Ym3_7FqqfxNg4` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-09-28 · tabs/sections read: Business Rules, Header, Hamburger(Profile), Body (single-tab doc) · read coverage: 100%

#### Content
##### Business Rules

**1. Onboarding, Registration, & Entry Rules**
- **Entry Point Convergence**: All users arriving via Social Media CTAs (LinkedIn or Meta ads) or through the direct website URL (Keydemand.in) must converge on the exact same registration URL.
- **Mandatory Registration Fields**: The onboarding flow requires capturing user details (Name, mobile number verified via OTP) alongside a single active demand (capturing Asset class, transaction type, city, location, Carpet area, and Floor).
- **T&C Consent**: Registration is gated by a mandatory clickable tick-box to accept the platform's Terms and Conditions.
- **Initial Free Posting Quota**: Upon initial registration, 1 demand is added to the brand's account. Users can subsequently add up to 2 more demands, allowing for a total of **3 free demands**.
- **Enterprise Integration Trigger**: If a registering user selects the "Enquire for Enterprise Solution" option during onboarding, the lead must be instantly transferred to the internal Keydemand team.
- **F&B Microsite Redirection**: For users acquired specifically via social media CTAs, the post-registration landing page must redirect them to a city-specific **Microsite for F&B**. This microsite dynamically displays listing relevancy, a supply summary, and an option to explore other property options.

**2. Brand Posting Restrictions & Asset Locks**
- **Asset Posting Restrictions**: Brands can post only demands of F&B. F&B Brands are permitted to add further F&B demands *only* after they are officially onboarded as enterprise users (which is triggered after 3 demands have been posted). They can explore Retail, F&B and Office.
- **Mandatory Brand Identity**: When a brand posts a demand, their official **company or brand name must be clearly displayed** on the listing.
- **Brand Logo and Card Display States**:
  - If a brand profile image has been uploaded, it must display directly on their demand card.
  - If no brand logo is provided, the system must automatically select a relevant placeholder image based on the chosen asset class.

**3. Account Lifecycle (Deactivation & Deletion)**
- **Manual Account Deletion Flow**:
  - Brands submit deletion requests by filling out a designated Form located under the Profile section.
  - Upon receipt of the form, the Keydemand team must manually reach out to the user to finalize account deletion.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deleting a profile results in the **permanent deletion** of all associated inventory.
- **Account Deactivation Flow**:
  - Brands can deactivate their accounts instantly by clicking the "Deactivate Account" button under their profile, which triggers a confirmation dialog box.
  - Deactivating the account pauses all activity: the user is marked inactive, and **all active listings are hidden** from public view on the platform.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deactivating a profile **pauses and deactivates** associated inventory.
  - **Reactivation**: A deactivated brand can return and reactivate at any time via a **"Reactivate account"** button on the homepage.

**4. Live Brand Dashboard & Relevancy Matching**
- **Real-time Dashboard Metrics**: The home page must link to a live, impromptu dashboard displaying:
  - **Demand Listings**: A summary of the total number of the brand's own demands across all asset classes, ordered newest first.
  - **Property Relevancy**: Total count of matching properties presented to the brand's demands.
  - **Leads/Enquiries**: Captures total phone number requests received.
  - **Enquiries Sent**: Captures contacts viewed, relevant projects, and outbound image requests.
- **My Demands Filters**: Under "My Demands", brands must be able to search and sort using:
  - *Filters*: Search by PropertyId, title, location, Asset Class, City, and Status (Active/Deactivated).
  - *Sorting*: Sort by newest first, most leads, and recent matches.
  - *Visual Priority*: Newest and unopened leads must be displayed first as cards.
- **Relevancy Sorting Priority**: Listings with active relevancy matches are automatically prioritized, pushed to the top of the feed, and flagged with a **red dot notification**.
- **Dynamic Relevancy Alerts**: Any new matched relevancy triggers a red dot over the dashboard counter. Clicking this tab automatically displays the latest matches at the top of the screen, highlighted with the red dot.
- **Leads Navigation**: Clicking on the dashboard "Leads" metric takes the brand directly to the Leads page, displaying open demands that have received leads (ordered newest first, e.g., showing specific lead counts per location).

**5. Inbound & Outbound Phone Number Requests**
- **Outbound Contact Reveal Logic (Brand viewing Property)**:
  - The property supplier's contact details are gated behind a Call-to-Action (CTA).
  - When a logged-in Brand user clicks to view a property's contact number, **both parties gain access to each other's contact information**.
  - The contact details are shared over WhatsApp with the brand.
  - The property owner/lister instantly receives an in-app lead notification and a WhatsApp alert containing the **Brand Name, User Type, Mobile Number, and Property Viewed**.
  - The lead is marked **"Unread"** on the lister's dashboard until they open the details.
- **Inbound Contact Requests Received (Agents/Admins viewing Brand)**:
  - Tracks the number of phone numbers requested on the brand's listings.
  - *Fields captured*: Name, Mobile Number, Property/Demand/Project ID, User-Type, Timestamp, and Accept/Reject buttons.
- **Brand-Only Accept/Reject Actions**:
  - The manual Accept/Reject options on contact requests apply **strictly to Brands** (as their demand cards feature a "Request Contact" CTA).
  - **SLA Window**: The brand has **4 working days** (excluding Saturdays and Sundays) to accept or reject the contact request.
  - **72-Hour Expiry**: If a request remains unanswered after **72 hours**, it is automatically dropped, nullified, and moved to "Rejected" status.
- **Outbound System Notifications (Sent to Requesting User)**:
  - *Approved*: "Your request to view phone number has been approved, kindly connect with them on \<number\>".
  - *Rejected*: "Your request to view the number and connect has been disallowed".
  - *Nullified/Expired*: "Your request to view number and connect has been unanswered and thus dropped".

**6. Outbound Image Requests**
- **Image Request Tracker**: Outbound image requests sent by the F&B brand to see similar properties must be tracked on a dedicated dashboard table.
- **Required Table Fields**: Project/Property ID (clickable and redirectable to the listing page), Asset Class, City, Location, Transaction Type, Posted By, and Date Requested.
- **Image Request Status Displays**:
  - **Accepted**: Shows the "Accepted" label with a **"View Images"** CTA (displays the property listing with images revealed).
  - **Pending**: Shows the "Pending" label (images remain locked).
  - **Rejected**: Shows the "Rejected" label with a **"View Listing without Images"** CTA (displays the listing without images).

**7. Dashboard Slider Interactions**
All dashboard summary metrics must open detailed sliding side panels according to this matrix:
- **Active Demand Card**: Clicking this scrolls the page down to the demands section.
- **Relevancy**: Clicking this scrolls the page down to the My Demands section.
- **Leads Received**: To see all leads, click "Leads Received." The slider will open and display all leads. When clicked on number of leads for demands, then it opens 2 tabs. It consists of phone number viewed, contact requests. **Phone number viewed** is on one tab where the slider will open and display the numbers viewed. and **Contact requests** received are on another. You can choose to accept or reject contact requests.
- **Enquiries Card**: To see the list of enquiries received, click "Enquiries Card." The slider will open and display all the enquiries with three tabs. **Projects Enquired:** To see a list of projects enquired, click "Projects Enquired." The slider will open and display the projects enquired, **Numbers Viewed:** It will open numbers viewed of agent, keydemand team and tenant, **Images Requested**: To see a list of images requested, click "Images Requested." The slider will open and display the images requested.
- **Your Listing - Demands**: To see the full list of your demands, click "Your Listing - Demands." The slider will open and display the list of demands.

**8. Interactive Projects & Callback Options**
- **Project Interest Inquiry**: Brands can show interest in Premium Projects, Exclusive Projects, or general city projects by clicking "Show Interest". This triggers a pre-filled form pulling details from their profile: **Name, Mobile, Email, and User Type**. Clicking submit displays the success message: "Thank you for showing interest".
- **Popular Cities Discovery**: Clicking "Explore" on popular city cards opens all properties and projects matching the chosen city.
- **Low-Abandonment Callback Button**: The "Request a Callback" button in the About section is designed to capture **only the mobile number as mandatory** to prevent form abandonment; name and email fields must be optional.
- **Calendly Booking Integration**: Submitting the callback form opens a specific Calendly link, allowing the brand user to book a slot for a live representative demo.

**9. Alerts, Notifications, & Support**
- **WhatsApp Notification Settings**: A toggle button under settings allows brands to choose whether they wish to receive notifications.
- **Notification Block Restriction**: Only promotional messages can be stopped; brands are strictly **blocked from disabling transactional WhatsApp messages** (e.g., matching relevancies, leads, interest received, or phone number enquiries).
- **Automated Confirmation Alerts**: When a brand adds a new demand, the platform automatically triggers a confirmation WhatsApp message to themselves containing the location details and a PDF download link of their listing.
- **Demand Active Status Alert**: An automated system check occurs **once every 3 months** to verify if the brand's demand is still active.
- **Help Desk**: Standard support is channeled via contact@keydemand.in along with a self-help chatbot(Phase 2), utilizing standard website FAQs.

#### Business rules extracted
- **BR-PG2-075** — All users arriving via Social Media CTAs (LinkedIn or Meta ads) or the direct website URL (Keydemand.in) must converge on the exact same registration URL. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-076** — Registration must capture user details: Name, and mobile number verified via OTP. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-077** — Registration must capture a single active demand: Asset class, transaction type, city, location, Carpet area, and Floor. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-078** — Registration is gated by a mandatory clickable tick-box to accept the platform's Terms and Conditions. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-079** — Upon initial registration, 1 demand is added to the brand's account; the user can subsequently add up to 2 more, for a total of 3 free demands. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-080** — If a registering user selects "Enquire for Enterprise Solution" during onboarding, the lead must be instantly transferred to the internal Keydemand team. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-081** — Users acquired via social media CTAs must be redirected post-registration to a city-specific Microsite for F&B that displays listing relevancy, a supply summary and an option to explore other property options. _(§ Business Rules 1)_
- **BR-PG2-082** — Brands can post only demands of F&B. Header "Post demand": "They can post only properties of F&B". _(§ Business Rules 2; Header 3)_
- **BR-PG2-083** — F&B Brands can explore (browse/view property cards of) Retail, F&B and Office asset classes under the global "Explore Properties" header; properties uploaded by anyone. _(§ Business Rules 2; Header 2)_
- **BR-PG2-084** — F&B Brands may add further F&B demands only after they are officially onboarded as enterprise users (triggered after 3 demands have been posted). _(§ Business Rules 2)_
- **BR-PG2-085** — When a brand posts a demand, its official company or brand name must be clearly displayed on the listing. _(§ Business Rules 2)_
- **BR-PG2-086** — If a brand profile image has been uploaded, it must display on the brand's demand card; if no logo is provided, the system must auto-select a placeholder image based on the chosen asset class. _(§ Business Rules 2)_
- **BR-PG2-087** — Account deletion is requested via a designated Form under the Profile section; on receipt the Keydemand team must manually reach out to the user to finalize deletion. _(§ Business Rules 3; Hamburger 2)_
- **BR-PG2-088** — Deleting a profile permanently deletes all associated inventory. _(§ Business Rules 3)_
- **BR-PG2-089** — Clicking "Deactivate Account" under the profile must trigger a confirmation dialog box; deactivation is instant on confirmation. _(§ Business Rules 3; Hamburger 2)_
- **BR-PG2-090** — Deactivation pauses all activity: the user is marked inactive, all active listings are hidden from public view, and associated inventory is paused and deactivated; the account itself remains. _(§ Business Rules 3; Hamburger 2)_
- **BR-PG2-091** — A deactivated user can reactivate at any time via a "Reactivate account" button on their home page. _(§ Business Rules 3; Hamburger 2)_
- **BR-PG2-092** — The home page must link to a live, impromptu dashboard showing: Demand Listings (total own demands across all asset classes, newest first), Property Relevancy (count of matching properties), Leads/Enquiries (phone number requests received), Enquiries Sent (contacts viewed, relevant projects, outbound image requests). _(§ Business Rules 4; Body 2)_
- **BR-PG2-093** — My Demands filters: Search by PropertyId, title, location; Asset Class; City; Status (Active/Deactivated). _(§ Business Rules 4; Hamburger 1)_
- **BR-PG2-094** — My Demands sort options: Newest first, most leads, recent matches. _(§ Business Rules 4; Hamburger 1)_
- **BR-PG2-095** — Newest and unopened leads must be displayed first as cards. _(§ Business Rules 4)_
- **BR-PG2-096** — Demand listings default to newest first, but listings with relevancy matches are pushed to the top and flagged with a red dot notification. _(§ Business Rules 4; Body 2.1)_
- **BR-PG2-097** — Any new matched relevancy shows a red dot over the dashboard counter; clicking it displays the latest matches on top, marked/highlighted as latest with the red dot. _(§ Business Rules 4; Body 2.2)_
- **BR-PG2-098** — Clicking the dashboard "Leads" metric opens the Leads page listing open demands that have received leads, newest first, with lead counts per location. _(§ Business Rules 4)_
- **BR-PG2-099** — A property supplier's contact details are gated behind a CTA. _(§ Business Rules 5)_
- **BR-PG2-100** — When a logged-in Brand user clicks to view/requests a property's contact number, both parties gain access to each other's contact information, and the contact details are shared over WhatsApp with the brand. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3 Phone number viewed)_
- **BR-PG2-101** — On a contact reveal, the property owner/lister receives an in-app lead notification and a WhatsApp notification containing Brand Name, User Type, Mobile Number and Property Viewed. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-102** — The lead is marked "Unread" by default on the lister's dashboard and changes to "Read" only when the lister opens the lead details. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-103** — Contact Requests (inbound; number of users who requested the brand's phone number) capture: Name, Mobile Number, Property/Demand/Project Id, User-Type, Timestamp, CTA Accept / Reject. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-104** — Accept/Reject on contact requests applies only to Brands (whose demand cards carry a "Request Contact" CTA), not to Office. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-105** — The brand has 4 working days from the date/time the request was sent to see/accept/reject a contact request; Saturdays and Sundays are skipped. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-106** — A contact request unanswered after 72 hours is automatically dropped/nullified and falls under "Rejected" status. _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-107** — The outbound request dashboard must track status as Accepted, Pending, or Rejected. _(§ Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-108** — On acceptance, the requester is notified: "Your request to view phone number has been approved, kindly connect with them on \<number\>". _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-109** — On rejection, the requester is notified: "Your request to view the number and connect has been disallowed" (Body 2.3 wording: "Your request to view number and connect has been disallowed"). _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-110** — On expiry (no response within 72 hours), the requester is notified: "Your request to view number and connect has been unanswered and thus dropped". _(§ Business Rules 5; Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-111** — Phone number viewed (outbound) records: Name, Mobile Number, Demand id, User-Type-I am a (F&B/Retail/Agent/Tenant/Keydemand team), Timestamp, and a Card (Property Id, Asset Class, Name of property, City, Location, Quoted Price, CTA- Call) that opens the detailed page on click. _(§ Body 2.3)_
- **BR-PG2-112** — Outbound image requests sent by the F&B brand must be tracked in a dashboard table with: Project/Property Id (clickable and redirectable to the listing), Asset Class, City, Location, Transaction Type, Posted By, Date Requested. _(§ Business Rules 6; Body 2.4)_
- **BR-PG2-113** — Image request status Accepted shows label "Accepted" and CTA "View Images" (listing with images); Pending shows label "Pending" (images locked); Rejected shows label "Rejected" and CTA "View Listing without Images" (listing without images). _(§ Business Rules 6; Body 2.4)_
- **BR-PG2-114** — Dashboard "Active Demand Card" click scrolls to the demands section; "Relevancy" click scrolls to the My Demands section. _(§ Business Rules 7)_
- **BR-PG2-115** — "Leads Received" opens a slider with all leads; clicking the number of leads for a demand opens 2 tabs: Phone number viewed and Contact requests (with accept/reject). _(§ Business Rules 7; Body Dashboard Slider Interactions)_
- **BR-PG2-116** — "Enquiries Card" opens a slider with three tabs: Projects Enquired, Numbers Viewed (of agent, keydemand team and tenant), Images Requested. _(§ Business Rules 7; Body Dashboard Slider Interactions)_
- **BR-PG2-117** — "Your Listing - Demands" opens a slider with the full list of the user's demands. _(§ Business Rules 7; Body Dashboard Slider Interactions)_
- **BR-PG2-118** — Project Interested: once the user has shown interest, the CTA must recall it as "You have already shown interest on <date>"; the slider shows Name of project, Project Id, Posted by, Location, City, Possession, Listed on, and "View Listing" opens the detailed page. _(§ Body 2.4)_
- **BR-PG2-119** — Numbers viewed (enquiries) records: Name, Mobile Number, Demand id, User-Type-I am a (F&B/Retail/Agent/Tenant//Keydemand team), Timestamp, Card (Property/Demand Id, Asset Class, Name of property, City, Location, Quoted Price, CTA- Call) opening the detailed page; covers numbers viewed on agent, Keydemand team, brand/office tenant listings. _(§ Body 2.4)_
- **BR-PG2-120** — "Show Interest" on Premium Projects, Exclusive Projects and Projects in \<city\> opens a form pre-filled from the profile (Name, Mobile, Email, User Type); on submit the message "Thank you for showing interest" is shown. _(§ Business Rules 8; Body 3, 4, 6)_
- **BR-PG2-121** — "Explore properties in \<city\>" cards have CTA "View Phone Number", which shows the number. _(§ Body 5)_
- **BR-PG2-122** — "Top cluster in \<city\>" is hidden for now. _(§ Body 7)_
- **BR-PG2-123** — "Explore" on popular city cards opens all properties/projects for the chosen city. _(§ Business Rules 8; Body 8)_
- **BR-PG2-124** — About Keydemand shows multiple videos only about Keydemand. _(§ Body 9)_
- **BR-PG2-125** — "Request a Callback" captures only the mobile number as mandatory; Name and Email must not be mandatory. Form fields: Name, Email, Phone number, I am - User types, Message. _(§ Business Rules 8; Body 9)_
- **BR-PG2-126** — Submitting the callback form opens a specific Calendly link so the user can book a slot for a live representative demo. _(§ Business Rules 8)_
- **BR-PG2-127** — Settings/Alerts must offer a WhatsApp toggle "Do you wish to receive Notifications?". _(§ Business Rules 9; Hamburger 4)_
- **BR-PG2-128** — Only promotional WhatsApp messages can be stopped; transactional messages (relevancy, leads, interest received, phone number enquiries) cannot be disabled. _(§ Business Rules 9; Hamburger 4)_
- **BR-PG2-129** — When the user adds a new demand, a WhatsApp to self is triggered confirming the location and giving a PDF download link of the listing. _(§ Business Rules 9; Hamburger 4)_

### Version 1.0 Office Tenant Home Page-Specific Page  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Google Doc · ID `1yRm2NnqeeEoXf4gXDSB8lGBY7xnczSEHFrI886pO-QE` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-10-03 · tabs/sections read: Business Rules, Header, Hamburger(Profile), Body (single-tab doc) · read coverage: 100%

#### Content
##### Business Rules

**Onboarding, Registration, & Entry Rules**
- **Registration Entry Points**: Both Social Media CTAs and the Direct registration link (Keydemand.in) route users to the exact same registration flow.
- **Mandatory Fields for Office Path**: When a user selects the **"Office Space"** path, the system must capture their **Transaction Type, Company Name, City, Location, Carpet Area, and a mandatory tick-box for T&C acceptance**.
- **Managed Office Lead Routing Checkbox**: The onboarding form contains a prompt asking: *"Also interested in Managed Office?"* alongside an option to *"Enquire for Enterprise Solution"*. If the user checks the managed office box, the inquiry is immediately sent to the Keydemand admin team for offline routing, though their standard office demand is still posted on the platform.
- **Post-Onboarding Microsite**: After registration is complete, the tenant is redirected to a **city-specific Microsite** that displays their listing relevancy, a supply summary, and a call-to-action to explore properties.
- Office Tenants can post Office and Managed Space only if they checked Also interested in Managed Space in initial onboarding form, otherwise they are allowed to post only office space. For Office Tenants, the company/brand name must be displayed when they post a demand.
- Office Tenants can explore both Managed Space and Office properties.

**Demand Limits & High-Value Enterprise Routing**
- **Posting Limits**: Office Tenants are strictly capped at posting **exactly 1 free demand**. To post any additional demands, they must be officially onboarded as an **Enterprise Solution** client.
- **High-Value Demand Routing**: If an Office Tenant submits a demand with a Carpet Area exceeding a city-specific threshold (e.g., **5,000 sq ft in Mumbai**), the system automatically flags it as **"High-Value"**.
  - *Visibility*: High-Value demands are completely hidden from external agents.
  - *Routing*: The lead is automatically routed exclusively to the internal Keydemand team for customized, offline handling.
- **Manual Enterprise Submissions**: Any demand where the user actively selects the "Enterprise Solution" prompt is instantly routed to the Keydemand admin team.

**Contact Sharing & Disclosure Logic**
- **Two-Way Reveal Mechanic**: When an Office Tenant clicks to view a supplier's phone number, the contact details are sent to the tenant via WhatsApp, and the supplier is simultaneously notified. This acts as a **two-way reveal**:
  - The viewer initiates the event passively without requiring an approval action.
  - Once clicked, both parties instantly receive each other's contact details.
  - The property lister/owner is sent a WhatsApp alert containing the **Viewer's Name, User Type, Mobile Number, and the specific listing viewed**.
  - The lead is displayed as **"Unread"** on the lister's dashboard until they actively click it.
- **Contact View Limits**: Non-enterprise Office Tenants are limited to viewing a maximum of **5 supplier contact numbers**. Attempting a 6th view triggers a block and prompts them to connect for the Enterprise Solution.

**Impromptu Live Dashboard & Metrics**
The platform features a live, impromptu dashboard linked directly from the homepage. Because there is no separate inbox, all demand responses, matches, and actions are accessed here.
- **Key Metrics Tracked**:
  - **Total Active Demands**: Displays a summary of the tenant's own demands, capturing the count of relevant properties, projects, and leads received.
  - **Property Relevancy**: The total number of listings matching the active demands.
  - **Leads/Enquiries (Inbound)**: Total count of users who have viewed the tenant's phone number.
  - **Enquiries Sent (Outbound)**: Total count of contact numbers viewed on external listings, alongside images requested and relevant projects.

**Listings Filters, Sorting, & Relevancy Flags**
- **My Demands Field Sorting**: The My Demands section displays the **DemandId, Asset Class, City, and Location**.
- **Card Priority States**: By default, demands are listed in the order of **newest first**, with newest and unopened leads prioritized on card views.
- **Relevancy Priority**: Any demand that has active property matches is automatically prioritized, pushed to the top of the feed, and flagged with a **red dot notification**.
- **Dynamic Relevancy Notifications**: When a new property-to-demand match occurs, a red dot appears over the relevancy count. Clicking this tab automatically displays the latest matching properties at the top of the screen, highlighted with the red dot.
- **Leads Dashboard Navigation**: Clicking the "Leads" metric on the dashboard redirects the tenant directly to their open demands that have active leads, displayed newest first with localized counts (e.g., *"Mahim property has 3 leads"* or *"Andheri property has 1 lead"*).

**Outbound Image Request Management**
When an Office Tenant requests to view hidden images on a property listing, the request and its current status are tracked on a dedicated dashboard table.
- **Table Tracking Fields**: Project/Property ID (clickable and redirectable to the listing page), Asset Class, City, Location, Transaction Type, Posted By, and Date Requested.
- **Status Indicators**:
  - **Accepted**: Shows the "Accepted" label alongside a **"View Images"** CTA, which reveals the property listing with images unlocked.
  - **Pending**: Shows the "Pending" label (images remain locked).
  - **Rejected**: Shows the "Rejected" label alongside a **"View Listing without Images"** CTA, which displays the property listing with the images withheld.

**Dashboard Slider Interactions**
All primary dashboard metrics are interactive and open sliding side panels based on the following configurations:
- **Active Demand Card**: Scrolls the homepage down directly to the active demands section.
- **Relevancy**: Scrolls the homepage down directly to the My Demands section.
- **Leads Received**: To see all leads, click "Leads Received." The slider will open and display all leads. When clicked on number of leads for demands, then it opens 1 tab. **Phone number viewed** where the slider will open and display the numbers viewed
- **Enquiries Card**: To see the list of enquiries received, click "Enquiries Card." The slider will open and display all the enquiries with three tabs. **Projects Enquired:** To see a list of projects enquired, click "Projects Enquired." The slider will open and display the projects enquired, **Numbers Viewed:** It will open numbers viewed of agent, keydemand team and tenant, **Images Requested**: To see a list of images requested, click "Images Requested." The slider will open and display the images requested.
- **Your Listing - Demands**: To see the full list of your demands, click "Your Listing - Demands." The slider will open and display the list of demands.

**Project Interactions & Popular Cities**
- **Project Interest Inquiry**: Office Tenants can submit interest in Exclusive Projects, Premium Projects, or city-specific projects. Clicking "Show Interest" automatically transmits their pre-filled profile details (**Name, Mobile, Email, and User Type**) as an official enquiry, displaying the confirmation message: *"Thank you for showing interest"*.
- **Popular Cities Discovery**: Clicking "Explore" on popular city cards opens all properties and projects matching the chosen city.
- **Top Clusters**: The "Top cluster in city" section is currently hidden.

**Account Lifecycle (Deactivation & Deletion)**
- **Deactivate Account**:
  - Brands/Tenants can deactivate their account via a button located in their profile, which triggers a mandatory confirmation dialogue box.
  - **System Behavior**: Deactivation pauses all account activity, hides all active demand listings from public view, and marks the user inactive.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deactivating a profile **pauses and deactivates** associated inventory.
  - **Reactivation**: The tenant can return and reactivate at any time via a **"Reactivate account"** button on the home page.
- **Delete Account**:
  - Tenants submit account deletion requests by filling out a designated Google _(sentence truncated in source)_
  - **System Behavior**: Upon receiving the form, the Keydemand admin team must manually reach out to the tenant to finalize account deletion.
  - **Inventory Impact**: Deleting a profile results in the **permanent deletion** of all associated inventory.

**Alerts, Notifications, & Support**
- **Notification Scope**: Includes Property Relevancies, Phone Number Requests, Marketing notifications, and the 3-month Demand Active Status check.
- **WhatsApp Setting Toggle**: A setting page toggle allows tenants to turn notifications on or off.
- **Transactional Message Lock**: Only marketing/promotional messages can be opted out of; tenants are strictly **blocked from disabling transactional WhatsApp messages** (e.g., messages regarding matching relevancies, leads, interest received, or phone number enquiries).
- **Auto-Alert Trigger**: When a tenant adds a new demand, the system automatically triggers a WhatsApp text to them confirming the listing location and providing a PDF download link.
- **Demand Expiry Check**: The system triggers an automated check **once every 3 months** to verify if a demand is still active.
- **Help Desk**: Standard support is channeled via contact@keydemand.in along with a self-help chatbot utilizing standard website FAQs.

### Version 1.0 Managed Space Tenant-Individual Home Page-Specific Page  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Google Doc · ID `1cMCQsHDnGx4qFZFhseFxIWb8-TBtU9vBImi8oBCV2AA` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-09-28 · tabs/sections read: Business Rules, Header, Hamburger(Profile), Body (single-tab doc) · read coverage: 100%

#### Content
##### Business Rules

**1. Posting Permissions & Asset Rules**
- **Authorized Posting Rights**:
  - **Managed Space Operators** are strictly restricted to posting **only Managed Space** listings.
  - If a Managed Space Tenant opts for Managed Space, the requirement is visible only to the Keydemand team. The requirement is not visible to external agents or operators directly
  - Managed Office supply(property) is added ONLY by the Keydemand team and cannot be added by agents.
- **Operator Administrative Workflow**: Managed office operators are treated identically to "Developers" on the platform. They are restricted from logging into the platform directly; instead, Keydemand teams collect all center/hub details offline and manually upload them.
- **Mandatory Company Identity**: The official **company or brand name must be clearly displayed** on the platform whenever they post a demand.
- **Asset Class Structural Nesting**: "Managed Space" is established as a new asset class nested entirely under the **"Projects"** structure rather than standard property inventory.
- **Transaction Parameter Locks**: Transaction options for Managed Space projects are strictly restricted to **"Lease"** (with traditional "Sale" and "Lead" parameters completely removed for this asset class).
- **Registration Field Requirements**: Selecting "Managed Space" as the user type during registration requires capturing: **Mobile number and OTP, Name, Company name, City, Location, and Number of seats**.
- **Onboarding Demand Limits**: Managed Space Tenants can initially add only **1 demand** upon registration. They are strictly blocked from adding further demands unless they are officially onboarded as enterprise users.
- **Consent and Upgrades**: Registration requires mandatory **T&C acceptance**. They have an option to *"Enquire for Enterprise Solution"*.
- **Demand Card Visual States**: If a profile brand image is uploaded by the tenant, it must display directly on their demand card; if not provided, the system auto-selects a placeholder based on the active asset class.

**2. Discovery & Navigation Logic**
- **Cross-Asset Exploration**: Managed Space Tenants are permitted to explore both **Managed Space** and standard **Office** properties.
- **Inventory Classification**: All inventory provided by managed operators (individual centers or coworking hubs) must be classified under **"Projects"** rather than standard individual property inventory.
- **Header Navigation Access**: The logged-in dashboard header features:
  1. **Keydemand Logo** (redirects back to the homepage).
  2. **Explore Properties** (allows users to explore properties uploaded by anyone with only the Managed Space Tenant asset class).
  3. **Post Demand** (restricts posting to properties of Managed Space Tenant).
  4. **Notifications**.
  5. **Enterprise Solution Hamburger (Profile Menu)**.
  6. **Live Dashboard**.
- **Requirement Visibility Lock**: If a Managed Space Tenant opts for Managed Space, their posted requirement is **visible only to the Keydemand team and admin**; it is completely hidden from external agents or operators.
- **Post-Registration Landing (Microsite)**: For users acquired via social media CTAs (LinkedIn or Meta), the post-registration landing page redirects to a city-specific **Microsite**. This microsite dynamically displays a managed supply summary, office/managed space city-specific relevancy, and an option to explore other properties.
- **Search Location Matching**: When demands are matched against properties, the cards are displayed directly below. Clicking "Explore Properties" displays similar properties located in the same geographical area as the user's active demand.
- **Blurred Property Cards**: On the Microsite, property cards are displayed as blurred, featuring a call-to-action button to request photos directly from the listing Agent.

**3. High-Value Routing & Enterprise Limits**
- **Asset Class Distinction**: "Managed Space" is under the **"Projects"** hierarchy to distinguish operator hubs from traditional properties.
- **Lease Enforcement**: All transactions for Managed Space projects must strictly and exclusively support **"Lease"**, removing traditional sale or general lead options.
- **High-Value Redirection**: If a Managed Space Tenant requests a size exceeding a custom, city-specific threshold (e.g., [XYZ sq ft] in a selected city), the system automatically flags the demand and transfers the lead to the Keydemand team for customized, offline handling.
- **Enterprise Features**: Managed office accounts are granted access features similar to those of an Enterprise user.
- **Notification Alerts**: Upon a new registration or demand capture, a system notification entry is logged in the admin central log, and an automated WhatsApp alert is sent directly to the Keydemand regional representative.

**4. Contact Reveal & Lead Tracking**
- **Contact Sharing Hook**: When a Managed Space Tenant clicks the CTA to view contact details, the contact number is shared with them via WhatsApp. Simultaneously, the supplier is notified.
- **Supplier Notification Rules**: The notified supplier will be the internal Keydemand team.
- **Two-Way Reveal Mechanic**: Viewing a phone number is a passive event requiring no approval action. Once clicked, both parties instantly gain access to each other's contact details.
- **Inbound Lister Lead Alerts**: The property owner/lister instantly receives a WhatsApp notification capturing the Viewer's Name, User Type, Mobile Number, and the specific Property/Demand ID viewed. The lead is displayed as **"Unread"** on the lister's dashboard until clicked.

**5. Dashboard & Account Lifecycle Rules**
- **Live Dashboard Structure**: The live, impromptu dashboard is built on or linked directly from the Homepage.
- **Dashboard Slider Interactions**:
  - *Active Demand Card*: Scrolls the page down to the demands section.
  - *Relevancy*: Scrolls the page down to the My Demands section.
  - **Leads Received**: To see all leads, click "Leads Received." The slider will open and display all leads. When clicked on number of leads for demands, then it opens 1 tab. **Phone number viewed** where the slider will open and display the numbers viewed
  - **Enquiries Card**: To see the list of enquiries received, click "Enquiries Card." The slider will open and display all the enquiries with three tabs. **Projects Enquired:** To see a list of projects enquired, click "Projects Enquired." The slider will open and display the projects enquired, **Numbers Viewed:** It will open numbers viewed of agent, keydemand team and tenant, **Images Requested**: To see a list of images requested, click "Images Requested." The slider will open and display the images requested.
  - **Your Listing - Demands**: To see the full list of your demands, click "Your Listing - Demands." The slider will open and display the list of demands.
- **My Listings Filters & Sorting**:
  - Allows the tenant to view their own demands across all asset classes, ordered **newest first**.
  - *Relevancy Highlighting*: Any demand listing with active relevancies is automatically prioritized, shown first in the feed, and highlighted with a **red dot notification**.
  - *Relevancy Tab Click*: Clicking the relevancy count displays the latest matches on top, marked or highlighted with a red dot as "latest".
- **Account Deactivation Flow**:
  - Brands/Tenants can deactivate their account via a button located under the user profile, requiring confirmation via a popup dialogue box.
  - *System Behavior*: Deactivation pauses all account activity, hides all active listings, and pauses active platform presence.
  - *Inventory Impact*: Deactivating a profile **pauses and deactivates** associated inventory.
  - *Reactivation*: The tenant can return and reactivate at any time via a **"Reactivate account"** button on the homepage.
- **Account Deletion Flow**:
  - Tenants submit account deletion requests by filling out a designated Form
  - *System Behavior*: Upon receiving the form, the Keydemand team must manually reach out to the tenant to finalize account deletion.
  - *Inventory Impact*: Deleting a profile results in the **permanent deletion** of all associated inventory.
